_comment: Assertions that really ARE about a comment. Every entry needs a reason -- the loader refuses an empty one. An exclusion with a reason is a decision; an exclusion without one is a silence.

expected.reason: the arm's subject IS the comment: it asserts the record that this file has no eval() survives.
